en: Vintage multi-view postcard with three monochrome photographic scenes of forested Idaho. The top-left image shows a log cabin in dense woods with a line of horses and riders in front. The bottom-left image shows a tall waterfall in a rocky gorge labeled "ELK CREEK FALLS," with a person standing near the base for scale. The large right-hand image shows a thick stand of tall pine trees labeled "WHITE PINE, IDAHO." Below the main image is printed the caption "Scene in the Pines, East of Moscow, Idaho." There is cursive handwriting in ink across the lower center and right portions of the card.
